name.km: សម្លប្រហើរសាច់គោ

description: A clear, herb-forward soup fragrant with lemongrass and basil.
descriptionKm: សម្លប្រហើរ — ស្រាល ឈ្ងុយក្រអូបនៃស្លឹក។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងស៊ុប

ingredients.itemKm: ទឹកស៊ុប ឬ ទឹក
ស្លឹកក្រូចសើច

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Prepare the beef: sliced thin against the grain.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់គោ៖ ហាន់ស្ដើងបញ្ច្រាសខ្សែ។

instructions.text: Simmer stock with bruised lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaf.
instructions.tip: Bruising or pounding the aromatics first lets them give up more flavour.

instructions.text: Add the beef and simmer until just browned but still tender, about 8 minutes.
instructions.textKm: ដាក់សាច់គោ ហើយដាំ រហូតទាល់តែលឿងស្រាល តែនៅទន់ ប្រហែល 8 នាទី។

instructions.text: Add the vegetables (napa cabbage, daikon) and simmer until just tender.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។

instructions.text: Taste — it should sing of salty, sweet and sour. Finish with Asian basil and spring onion.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
